character.name: Varin
character.background: Disgraced noble, falsely accused of treason
traits: Unwavering Honesty: Cannot knowingly utter a falsehood, even when deception would save their life.
Haunted by Betrayal: Has disadvantage on Charisma checks when interacting with nobles of their former homeland.
Oath-Wracked Guilt: Suffers nightmares of their failed oath, and has disadvantage on saving throws against fear effects.
Veteran Fighter: Proficient with all martial weapons and armor, even without divine favor.
character.gear: Dented longsword · Tarnished silvered shield · Dented chain shirt · Leather journal of false evidence · Vial of pine-scented healing potion · 3 days of hard travel rations · Worn iron tinderbox · Rough-spun grey wool cloak
character.story: Varin of House Dain was the realm’s most promising knight, framed for regicide by his own cousin. Stripped of title, divine favor, and honor, he fled to the blighted northern marches. His broken oath—refusing to slaughter innocent peasant rebels his cousin ordered him to kill—was no accident, but proof of his integrity the traitor twisted into treason. Now he roams the frozen wilds, hunting the man who stole his life, and the truth that will restore his name.

inventory.name: Dented longsword
inventory.lore: This sword was forged for Varin’s knighting ceremony, gifted by his late father. The deep gash along the blade came from the duel where he was framed for treason, and it has never been sharpened since.
inventory.description: Dented steel longsword, hilt wrapped in frayed black leather, the Varin family crest almost worn off the pommel.

inventory.name: Tarnished silvered shield
inventory.lore: The shield bears the crest of House Varin, now scratched through with a traitor’s mark. It was seized during Varin’s public disgracing, but he stole it back from the royal armory the night he escaped the capital.
inventory.description: Round silver shield, tarnished from disuse, dented from the ambush that framed Varin, the traitor’s sigil carved crudely into the painted crest.

inventory.name: Dented chain shirt
inventory.lore: This chain shirt was passed down through three generations of House Varin, and still bears the dents from the ambush that framed its wearer. The links are rusted in places from weeks of travel through the wet northern marches.
inventory.description: Dented but well-maintained chain shirt, sized for a human of average build, the Varin family crest embossed on the left pauldron.

inventory.name: Leather journal of false evidence
inventory.lore: Varin filled this journal with witness testimonies and proof of his innocence before his arrest. The pages are stained with blood from the night he was framed, and several entries are smudged from tears he refused to shed.
inventory.description: Frayed leather journal, pages filled with cramped handwriting and pinned scraps of evidence, sealed with a broken wax stamp of the royal court.

inventory.name: Pine-scented healing potion
inventory.lore: This potion was brewed by Varin’s former maid, who snuck it to him during his imprisonment. It tastes of pine and sorrow, and has a faint golden glow that dims when opened.
inventory.description: Small glass vial filled with a golden, viscous liquid that smells of pine.

inventory.name: Hard travel rations
inventory.lore: These rations were stolen from the castle stores the night Varin escaped. They are dry, tasteless, and have kept him alive through weeks of hiding in the wilds.
inventory.description: Hard, crumbly travel biscuits, wrapped in waxed cloth to keep them dry.
inventory.effects: Provides one day of sustenance for a human when eaten.

inventory.name: Worn iron tinderbox
inventory.lore: This tinderbox was a gift from Varin’s childhood friend, who died in the ambush that framed him. He carries it as a reminder of who he is fighting for, and the life he lost.
inventory.description: Worn iron tinderbox, flint still sharp, a small engraving of a wolf on the lid.
inventory.effects: Can be used to start a fire in 1 minute, provided tinder is available.

inventory.name: Rough-spun grey wool cloak
inventory.lore: This cloak was given to Varin by a peasant family who hid him from the king’s men. It is mended in several places, and smells of wood smoke and wet earth from the northern marches.
inventory.description: Thick, coarse wool cloak, dark grey, with a deep hood that can be pulled low to hide his face.
inventory.effects: Provides resistance to cold damage from non-magical sources.
